GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Best away. Pushed fwd & raced 2nd on inside (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd on inside midrace & Two Wide @ 500m & pushed to quicken @ 400m. Pushed along 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Four Wide in last 250m. # On-pace/weakened.
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3 Wide 5t 3 Lengths 800m Went Forward 3 Wide Outside Leader .5 Lengths home turn 3 Wide Under Pressure 3rd weakened final 200m # wide/on pace/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping.  Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well. Pushed fwd to share lead on inside early . Stayed =lead on inside midrace & 1 length clear on inside on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & 2 Lengths clear @ 200m. Faded late but held on. # On-pace/held on.

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4th 6 Lengths Two Wide (good pace), 3 Wide from 800m, maintained 4th place to 9 Lengths 3 Wide turning (leader led 4 lengths), shifted onto fence Straightening Up and technically improved while losing position in Straight # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, from the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Wide out. Quickly Crossed up Settled Down Two Wide 2nd within 1 length @ 600m. same to straightening up . Clear All The Way Just couldn't finish off final 200m. $2.70 Winner Led All The Way # sat 2nd/winner led
Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then steered 3-4 Wide Straightening Up , Lost Ground in Straight # weakened in str.

Jumped okay & Went Forward to lead on fence by a long neck, Held Together in front & led a half length turning, Headed Straightening Up and Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey stated it led, enjoyed moderate sectionals but failed to sprint strongly on straightening and was very disappointing to the line, racing like a tired horse. Trainer agreed and advised he would freshen it up prior to its next start. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, apprentice stated her mount led the event enjoyed moderate sectionals in the early and middle stages. App stated her mount failed to sprint strongly on straightening and was very disappointing in its run to the line. App stated that her mount raced like a tired horse. Trainer agreed and advised he would freshen the mare up prior to its next race start. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well rails gate settled down right up there holding fence in a line of many (800m), cornered marginal leader, still there until final 70m # pace/pressured
Jumped Ok went through on fence to lead. led turn going well. got clear in Straight . found enough # too speedy
Jumped best and Went Forward to 1 length Lead on fence, Held Together in front, led 1.5 Lengths turning, kept going in straight, running on tired legs final 100m or So # led/just lasted
Jumped Ok , showed speed to cross and lead 800m, rolled off fence but gave good kick straightening, fought off late challenge for all way win # led all the way
